stock: installed semiconductor wafer-fabrication capacity in leading-edge logic and HBM/DRAM
note: Fails the two new measures badly. LOOP: each tool generation raises compute supply which creates the AI workloads that demand the next fab - a self-reinforcing treadmill rather than a correction. COUPLING: roughly three-quarters of sales are new-equipment capex so revenue shrinks hard at capacity equilibrium; only field solutions on the installed base survives. BUFFER: manufacturing is single-country Japan (Miyagi; Yamanashi; Iwate; Kumamoto) and the customer base is a handful of fabs (TSMC; Samsung; SK Hynix; Micron) with China at 38.6% of Q1 FY2026 sales falling to 26.8% by Q4 under export controls. Balance sheet is pristine (Y409.6B net cash; zero debt) and momentum is real (record FY2026 revenue Y2.44T; H1 FY2027 guided +33%) but the rubric no longer rewards that. No jurisdiction penalty applied - Japan-domiciled.
